name: Noachian-Carn
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near petrified remnants of a former biosphere that no expedition has ever claimed.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
